name: claude-agent-manager
description: Live, read-only monitor for your Claude Code agents and subagents — tree, activity, tokens, diffs, and full-text conversation search in a VS Code sidebar.
author: Damilola Onadeinde

commands.title: Claude Agents: Open in Editor (full screen)
Claude Agents: Toggle Scope (Workspace / All Projects)
Claude Agents: Cycle Layout (Tree / Cards / Split)

claudeAgentManager.claudeHome.markdownDescription: Path to your Claude home directory. Leave empty to use `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude`.

claudeAgentManager.scope.description: Show sessions for the current workspace folder only, or across all projects.

claudeAgentManager.defaultLayout.description: Which of the three layouts to show by default.

claudeAgentManager.activeThresholdSecond.description: An agent whose transcript was modified within this many seconds is considered running.

claudeAgentManager.maxSessions.description: Maximum number of recent sessions to monitor at once.

claudeAgentManager.maxSubagents.description: Maximum number of recent subagents to show per session.

claudeAgentManager.maxLogLines.description: Maximum number of log lines kept per agent in the live view.

claudeAgentManager.pollSeconds.description: Fallback polling interval (seconds) used alongside the file watcher.

claudeAgentManager.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when a running agent finishes or errors.

enumDescriptions: Open the session in the Claude Code extension's editor view (resumes the exact session; falls back to terminal if the extension isn't installed).
Resume the session in an integrated terminal via `claude --resume <id>`.
claudeAgentManager.continueIn.description: Where the 'Continue' action opens a session. You can also pick per-click from the Continue dropdown.
